_meta.description: MOCK Kalshi GET /markets response for Poonji phase-1 calculator. Shaped to match the real Kalshi trade-api/v2 response so phase-2 can swap mock -> live with no frontend change.
_meta.source_note: Prices marked price_status:'live' are real snapshots (Kalshi/Polymarket, 2026-07-07). Prices marked 'illustrative' are placeholders pending a chosen strike, to be replaced by the live API in phase 2.
_meta.price_convention: All prices in cents, integers 1-99. A yes_bid of 43 = 43% implied probability. no_price = 100 - yes_price.
_meta.poonji_note: The 'poonji_derived' block on each market is NOT part of the Kalshi API. It shows the two values the calculator computes client-side from the raw fields, included here so you can review what the calculator reads.

markets.title: Fed cuts rates at least once in 2026
markets.yes_sub_title: Yes – at least one cut by year-end
markets.rules_primary: Resolves Yes if the Federal Reserve cuts its target range at least once between Feb 26, 2026 and Dec 31, 2026.

markets.title: Democrats win control of the House (2026 midterms)
markets.rules_primary: Resolves Yes if the Democratic Party wins a majority of voting seats in the U.S. House in the Nov 3, 2026 election.

markets.title: Brent crude above $100/bbl at year-end 2026
markets.rules_primary: Resolves Yes if front-month Brent crude settles above $100.00/bbl on the final trading day of 2026.

markets.title: Major Strait of Hormuz shipping disruption in 2026
markets.rules_primary: Resolves Yes if a credible source reports a major closure or blockade of the Strait of Hormuz for 24+ hours in 2026.

markets.title: 18+ named Atlantic storms in the 2026 season
markets.rules_primary: Resolves Yes if NOAA records 18 or more named Atlantic storms in the 2026 hurricane season.
